title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Account Services Schedule — Buyers, Job Names, Purchase Orders and Tax-Exempt Purchasing
content:
The account services available on a Ridgeline Pro Credit account depend on its tier.

| Tier | Maximum authorized buyers | Maximum active job names | Business may require a purchase order number on every invoice | Tax-exempt purchases with a valid certificate on file | Sales tax credit look-back (calendar days after the invoice date) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge | 5 | 10 | No | Yes | 90 |
| Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge Plus | 10 | 25 | Yes | Yes | 90 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 30 | 25 | 50 | Yes | Yes | 90 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 30 Select | 50 | 100 | Yes | Yes | 90 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 45 | 99 | 250 | Yes | Yes | 120 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 60 Enterprise | 250 | 500 | Yes | Yes | 180 |

## Terms used

- **Authorized buyers** are employees of the business with purchasing authority on the account.
- **Active job names** are the names under which invoices can be tracked at one time.
- **Purchase order requirement**: where the tier allows it, the business may require a purchase order number on every invoice. The Pro Revolving Charge does not offer this option.
- **Sales tax credit look-back**: the calendar days after the invoice date within which sales tax charged on an exempt purchase can be credited back.

Hypothetical illustration: a business on the Pro Revolving Charge Plus already has 10 authorized buyers; 10 is the tier's maximum, so the count stands at the limit.
